postings.title: Production Associate
postings.description: Ridgeline Metal Works needs a production associate on the day shift. You move parts, run a press, and check finished work. The team trains you on the job. You need an OSHA 10 card.

postings.title: Warehouse Selector
postings.description: Blackwater Logistics is hiring a warehouse selector for evenings. You pull orders and load pallets. Lifting is part of the job. A forklift card helps but is not required.

postings.title: Certified Nursing Assistant
postings.description: New River Care Home is hiring a CNA for the night shift. You help residents with daily care and keep notes. You need a CNA licence and a background check.

postings.title: Front Desk Associate
postings.description: Cheat River Hospitality wants a friendly front desk associate. You greet guests, take bookings, and answer the phone. Weekend shifts are part of the job.

postings.title: Grocery Stocker
postings.description: Kanawha Valley Grocers needs a stocker for the early morning crew. You unload trucks and fill shelves before the store opens.

postings.title: Machine Operator
postings.description: Coalfield Machine and Tool is hiring a machine operator. You set up the machine, run parts, and measure them. Overtime is offered. You need an NCCER core card.

postings.title: Print Finisher
postings.description: Appalachian Print and Sign needs a print finisher. You cut, fold, and pack finished work. Careful hands matter more than experience.

postings.title: Home Health Aide
postings.description: Seneca Home Health is hiring aides to visit clients at home. You help with meals, cleaning, and getting around. You need a driver's license and CPR training.

postings.title: Building Supply Cashier
postings.description: Elk Fork Building Supply wants a cashier. You ring up sales, help customers find items, and keep the front tidy.

postings.title: Data Entry Clerk
postings.description: Mountain State Data Services needs a data entry clerk. You type records, check them, and fix errors. The work is quiet and steady.
